test_fixed_cropper: test the FixedCropper class that crops a fixed subwindow from an observation with padding support
test_egocentric_scrolling: test the ScrollingCropper class that tracks game entities and scrolls the observation window egocentrically
test_scrolling_saccade: test the saccade feature of ScrollingCropper that jumps to follow a new scroll target when the tracked entity leaves the window
test_scrolling_margins: test ScrollingCropper scroll margins that constrain how far the window can pan vertically and horizontally
test_scrolling_initial_offset: test ScrollingCropper initial_offset parameter that shifts the scrolling window for dramatic effect
